# ACTEC - The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel

> > The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (ACTEC) is a professional organization of trust and estate attorneys providing member resources, legal publications, and professional development.

ACTEC serves as the premier professional association for trust and estate counsel, offering Fellows access to substantive committees, continuing legal education, and an extensive archive of law journals including the historic Probate Notes series dating back to 1975.

## Key Topics

- Trust and Estate Law
- ACTEC Fellows
- Probate Notes
- ACTEC Law Journal
- Member Services
- Substantive Committees
- Estate Planning
- Professional Development
- Legal Publications
- Member-Access Resources
- Annual Meetings
- Committee Work
- Trust Counsel
